atomic_facts.claim: Network configuration on Ubuntu is handled through Netplan.
Netplan defines network setup through YAML configuration files.
Netplan integrates with NetworkManager and systemd-networkd.

learning_levels.L0: Netplan is the Ubuntu network configuration layer.
learning_levels.L1: Netplan uses YAML files to describe network setup.
learning_levels.L2: A practitioner reads and edits Netplan YAML for address, gateway, DNS, and interface configuration.
learning_levels.L3: A professional validates renderer behavior between NetworkManager and systemd-networkd.
learning_levels.L4: An expert studies boot-time ordering, renderer behavior, and failure recovery.
learning_levels.L5: A researcher studies declarative network configuration models and deterministic network state convergence.

canonical_policy.reason: Contains source-backed atomic facts with official Ubuntu documentation.
